approval_terms: Option B. At most three maker-only windows 0500z/0630z/0800z on l5-btc5m-live; start SHA 9de1e1189; successor SHA only if it changes BTC5m controller/execution logic only (not authorization, limits, halts, watchdog, account-risk), passes targeted regressions and full-suite baseline parity, deployed disarmed and verified before arming. Per window <=$0.45 exposure, <=20 orders (OPEN 4/COMPLETE 8/REPLACE 6), taker disabled. Campaign realized net-loss limit $1.35 incl fees; cap reduced to remaining budget with $0.02 fee reserve; fail closed if anything unreconciled. Account $5 daily / $25 lifetime unchanged; watchdog required; BTC15m disarmed; no overlap; skipped windows not replaced; no unchanged configuration repeated after evidence it is economically unsound.
